name: Don Sebastian Pauccar Flores
reason: No own website, published email or contact form found in two web searches: he appears only on Kripalu's page and third-party retreat/tour listings (Retreat.guru, BookRetreats, some of which pair Q'ero ceremonies with ayahuasca retreats run by others). A Q'ero paqo who travels with organisers rather than running his own site, so no page can be built from his own sources.
